SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, IFNULL(SUM(pay_amount), 0) as value FROM oms_order WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND delete_status = 0 AND status IN (1, 2, 3) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, COUNT(*) as value FROM oms_order WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND delete_status = 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date
